title: When the Promise Burns
author: Orsen Hartwell
blurb: Ulyana Vane, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
